messages:
Mira: quick heads-up — I'm proposing a small shape change in console/ingest to support policy-proxy routing + quota gating. TL;DR: add policy_proxy_attrs (jsonb) + route_policy_version (int) to routes table; dual-write shim for 6w and background backfill.

Jay: can you sketch the reason? why not reuse route_tags?

Mira: route_tags is overloaded (ui+quota+routing). We need structured attrs for the new policy proxy to evaluate rules efficiently. JSONB keeps it flexible and avoids churn of enum changes. plan: new column + version int so we can evolve without breaking runtime checks.

Sam: will this change blow up dashboard p99s? our tenant pages already have heavy joins.

Mira: good call. console will keep reading route_tags until flag lift. we add a route_attributes materialized view (tenant-level pre-aggregation) for heavy dashboards and only switch UI to that view after canary. Also keep read-path fallback for 4 weeks.

Ana: telemetry/analytics side: please add policy_proxy_version to ingest telemetry envelope so analytics can join. backfill will create extra telemetry events (schema-change marker + write churn). estimate +2-3% event volume for 24-48h during backfill.

Jay: shim details? will dual-write duplicate indexes and cause bloat?

Mira: shim will dual-write but we will avoid creating a full-text/index duplicate on the old column. migration steps: add columns with safe defaults, populate policy_proxy_attrs with a minimal structure, create targeted GIN indexes on the JSON path we query (eg (policy_proxy_attrs->'primary')), and run backfill in tenant-scoped batches. avoid global locks.

Sam: sounds fine. what's the rollback plan if backfill shows corruption?

Mira: we keep a reversible backfill: write to new columns only, verify checksums per-batch against canonical route_id -> route_tags mapping, and keep a toggle to stop dual-write and roll back consumer reads to route_tags. also snapshot a small sample of affected rows pre-migration for quick integrity checks.

Mira: migration SQL prototype (for review):

```sql
BEGIN;
ALTER TABLE routes ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS policy_proxy_attrs jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb;
ALTER TABLE routes ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS route_policy_version int DEFAULT 1;
-- avoid broad indexes; add targeted GIN for the primary lookup path
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_routes_policy_primary ON routes USING gin ((policy_proxy_attrs->'primary'));
COMMIT;
```

Mira: backfill plan: tenant-scoped batches, throttled by CPU and db tx rate, parallel workers with per-tenant ordering, sample verification, and alerts on checksum divergence. dual-write window target: 6 weeks.

Jay: test plan? recommend a canary tenant + console dark read + dashboard smoke tests + nightly analytics join verification.

Mira: agreed. I'll draft rollout doc and QA checklist. Adding rollout windows and owner list. tagging infra for scheduling.

infra-bot: deploy scheduled: migration-job-runner v2 -> canary 03/25 01:00 UTC

Sam: ack. I'll coordinate with dashboard owners and add the dark-read smoke checks. :thumbsup:
